capabilities: Create a starter ingredient hierarchy and cabinet notes
Add recipes by hand, pasted text, or web page address
Track bottle stock, purchases, and restock needs
Log drinks, subtract stock, and add entries to daily notes
Rank makeable recipes and shopping-list priorities
extras: Beta: note properties may change before 1.0 and mobile is less tested. No importer for existing cocktail collections. Fetches only the single recipe page you give it; no telemetry. Requires Obsidian 1.12.2 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to link cocktail recipes to bottle stock, see what you can make, or plan what to buy next.

relations.evidence: with the core Bases plugin enabled (Settings → Core plugins)

summary: Cocktail recipe and home-bar inventory manager that stores recipes, bottle stock, and shopping lists as Markdown notes with Bases views.
